title: Cut neural-field comets regrow: 6 of 8 comets that lose 29-55% of their activity re-form a head and wake within 30-100 t and keep travelling, but undamaged comparators grow 1.4-1.9x in the same window, so regrowth is intrinsic growth, not repair to a set size
summary: First step of Q:comet-cut-repair. I added a damage hook to c20's depression-comet world (erased activity reset to rest, adaptation cleared, resource untouched) and used labkit's --damage on mature compact comets: half cuts of 40% and core cuts of 30% on seeds 0-1 (t=500, frames every 5 t), half and core cuts of 50% on fresh seeds 2-3 (frames every 1 t). In 6 of 8 cuts the comet re-forms its active head and adaptation wake and keeps moving: area back to 1.07-2.0x pre-cut within 30-100 t, before it merges or breaks like any comet. In one case it regrew from a sub-threshold remnant. The 2 losses are the same 18 px comet (0.58x median) on seed 2, where the tracker also lost the comparator within 3 t. The comparators grow 1.38-1.87x over the same window, so these comets have no set-point size: the cut comet regrows by the same growth that makes comets elongate and break. This is recovery of the body plan, but not maintenance of a size. The second step of the question (a self-made slow inhibitor that gives a set point) is untested.

finding.operator: activity-adaptation comets with synaptic depression (Amari field), cut by labkit --damage
finding.control: labkit's undamaged comparator in the same run (similar size); 2 cut geometries x 2 sizes x 2 seeds each
finding.result: 6/8 cut comets back to >= 1.07x pre-cut area within 30-100 t and motile; comparators grow 1.38-1.87x in the same window; 2/8 lost (one small comet, both cuts, seed 2)
